requests.body: Request changes on PR #132 (build(0003)). The preflight parked gate (c) on the test target: tests/test_policy_skills.py::test_security_baseline_check_finds_secrets_and_dangerous_calls fails because template/lessons/README.md line 87 reads "the lesson and the eval (/sdlc-deploy step 0b)" and the security-baseline scanner's pattern eval\s*\( matches the prose "eval (". Reword the sentence so the word "eval" is never followed by an opening parenthesis, for example "the lesson and the eval case, in /sdlc-deploy step 0b", and check the rest of the README and the two command files for the same shape. Then finish phase (c): the adversarial verdict, gate (c) and the PR summary, which the first run did not reach (it hit the 200-turn cap after the verifier's evidence). No other change.
